title: sesleria varia subsp. islandica
intro: Sesleria varia subsp. islandica, commonly known as Icelandic hair grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Icelandic hair grass on human health and its potential therapeutic applications.
